t: A short one, when you cannot manage more
a: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِى يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
p: Rabbanā āmannā fa-ghfir lanā wa-rḥamnā wa anta khayru-r-rāḥimīn.
m: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
